title: PadPilot (AGA steering, Horizon camera, QuickShift)
tag_line: Gamepad steering assist with rally mode, a dynamic chase camera and quicker automatic shifting, in one app
message: One mod, one app (UI Apps > PadPilot): AGA gamepad steering (Off / Grip / Rally, View button toggles Grip/Rally), Horizon chase camera, QuickShift coast downshifts and fast D/R changes.
